sources.entry: Docspell - Auto-tagging document organizer and archive. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 Scala/Java/Docker

summary.one_liner: Docspell is a self-hosted personal document organizer and document management system that handles scanned papers, emails and other files with OCR, full-text search and ML-assisted tagging.
summary.what_it_does: Docspell unifies files from scanners, emails and other sources into one archive aimed at households and small groups. It associates documents with tags, correspondents and other predefined or custom metadata, and makes them searchable. It runs OCR on documents when needed and provides full-text search. Machine learning features suggest correspondents, guess tags and find dates, using the GPL-licensed Stanford Core NLP library. It offers e-mail integration, a REST/HTTP API, a mobile-friendly Elm single-page web UI, an Android app for uploads and a command-line client.
use_cases: suggest correspondents and dates for files
notable: Machine-learning metadata suggestions that learn from existing documents
REST/HTTP API plus Android app and CLI
Multiple install options: Docker, deb package, zip, Nix/NixOS module, Helm chart
caveats: Docker quick start requires docker-compose; other install paths are documented externally
Relies on external tools such as tesseract, unoserver and ocrmypdf for file processing
The README describes the project as targeted at home use and smaller groups
